raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your partner support team is currently exploring options and has not yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To ensure we align with your needs, we would like to schedule a discovery meeting to clarify your requirements and discuss how Cedar Systems can support your workflow coordination and account reporting needs.

Please let us know a convenient time for you, and we will be happy to arrange the meeting.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
